title: Australian man is taken on guided journey of the universe

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Standing upright on the ground next to his ICU bed/body (not hovering at ceiling as in prior OBEs).
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt 'evaporating' out of body; initial alarm/confusion, then felt very alive, vibrant, free/wholesome.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: An 'infinite dark space/void' that later 'took on the shape of a tunnel of sorts'.

arrival.other_being_detail: A guide/helper 'Tom/Thomas' who initially appeared as a casually dressed doctor with a stethoscope; escorted him and taught him.

environment.environment_other_detail: Edwardian two-story house with garden; cities, halls of learning, offices; 'homes of rest'; shopping mall; spheres/realms including darker spheres; no shadows; thought-responsive environment.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Chose to return to tell people, change public perception of death, reduce fear of dying.
boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Brought back by Tom to ICU bedside; then waited beside body until doctors woke him; describes consciousness 'moving into reverse' as physical world materialized through eyelids.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Go back to Earth to help change the public perception of death; tell people dying should not be feared; share what he learned.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Perforated stomach ulcer; emergency surgery; failure to awaken from anesthesia; intubated and placed in coma/ICU.

person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: States he was 'never...a religious man in any way'.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Extensive guided tour/teaching about multiple 'spheres' of spirit world; thought-travel; observation of another person's post-death awakening; later brief reunions with deceased friends/family.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in ICU with interaction with guide first; then dark-void passage with life review occurring during transit; later void becomes tunnel leading to bright light; then arrival in earthlike environment/house; later returns to ICU with explicit choice.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Life review described as simultaneous 'everything at once' with ability to zoom into details.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Long, detailed 'guided tour' cosmology: seven spheres/levels, offices administering deaths, halls of learning, shopping malls, spirit technology, thought-constructed buildings; observation of a newly dead man (Andrew) being awakened by helper; extensive doctrinal commentary; reincarnation/world-of-souls framework; claims of future knowledge (not detailed).
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "OH MY GOD, THIS IS IT! NICE KNOWING YOU, WORLD....."; "All of a sudden, my entire life flashed before my eyes, complete in every detail."; "Up ahead at the end of the tunnel, I could see what appeared to be a bright light..."; "...a feeling of unconditional love and acceptance poured into that empty space."; "the decision to return to earth was mine to make."
